title: MLB Logo Quiz Part 2: Hard Mode
headline: MLB Logo Quiz Part 2: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard MLB logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of MLB team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current MLB team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

How Every MLB Team Got Its Name

items.piece: The black shadow under the bottom of the red C.
items.fact: The Reds first wore the wishbone C in 1905 and have worn it in some form every season since 1909.

items.piece: Orange, black and a white highlight at the back of the bird's cap.
items.fact: The cartoon bird came back to Orioles caps in 2012, a new drawing that combined parts of the 1970 and 1983 birds.

items.piece: The teal outline, black and red at the bottom left of the A.
items.fact: The Sedona Red A with a teal outline returned to the home jersey in the 2024 uniform set.

items.piece: The orange ring at the top of the circle, against navy.
items.fact: The star with a block H returned for 2013. It is the mark the Astros wore on their caps from 1965 to 1993.

items.piece: A black curve with its silver outline, from the bottom of the S.
items.fact: The Old English Sox was the star of the White Sox's 1990 rebrand and became a hip-hop staple after Ice Cube wore the cap.

items.piece: The silver and black foot of the R.
items.fact: The Rockies unveiled their name and logo on July 5, 1991, before their first season in 1993.

items.piece: The bottom left corner of the C: red with a navy outline.
items.fact: The Diamond C grew out of the old Block C. Its point echoes the diamond shapes on top of the Guardians of Traffic statues.

items.piece: A curl of the Olde English D, navy against white.
items.fact: In 2018 the Tigers made the cap's Olde English D the official logo and put it on the home jersey too, so the two finally match.
